main:2.text: Back in current day New York City, Peter and Miles are helping with the clean-up and rescue operations left in Marko's wake, as they notice that the Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man App is down. Ganke resolves to fix it as he informs Peter of a location where citizens require help. Ganke also works with Peter to 3D print a drone to serve as a makeshift local network, allowing Peter to receive reports from citizens.

main:3.text: Show Me New York is the third main mission Marvel's Spider-Man 2, originating in Little Odessa. Peter Parker is looking for new work after getting fired from his teaching job. On advice from Miles Morales, Peter begins working with Robbie Robertson, who is looking for photos that capture the spirit of New York City. Peter receives a call from Miles, who extends his condolences for Peter getting fired.

main:4.text: Roll Like We Used To is the fourth main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man 2, originating in Astoria. Peter Parker meets with Mary Jane Watson at May Parker's old house and the two begin to reminisce about the past. Peter then finds himself joining an old friend on a daring escapade through his old school. Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson meet in front of May Parker's house, where Peter is currently living.

main:5.text: Not On My Watch is the fifth main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man 2, taking place in Upper East Side. Peter Parker and Miles Morales head to The Raft to oversee a high-profile prison transfer, with unexpected interruptions and foundation-shaking encounters. Miles Morales heads to The Raft to meet with Peter Parker and assist him with overseeing a prison transfer.

main:6.text: Amends is the sixth main mission of Marvel's Spider-Man 2, taking place in Harlem. Miles Morales meets with his uncle Aaron Davis about making amends, and putting his life as the Prowler fully behind him. Miles Morales suddenly gets a call from his uncle Aaron Davis, wanting to meet with him and blames Miles for being too busy to visit his family.

main:11.text: Miles Morales and Ganke decide to leave Coney Island after Miles's experience inside the Mysterium. Peter Parker, Mary Jane Watson, and Harry Osborn decide to have a night of fun at Coney Island to celebrate Harry's recovery and the launch of the Emily-May Foundation. The trio decide to play a myriad of games and attractions at the park, starting with Hydro Park.

main:12.text: Peter Parker arrives at the Emily-May Foundation, where he encounters Harry Osborn practicing the usage of his symbiote powers. Harry places a marker on a table on the other side of their office. Harry asks Peter why he was not told about him being Spider-Man but Mary Jane Watson was, and he also figures out that Miles Morales is the other Spider-Man.

main:13.page: Hunt to Live, Live to Hunt
main:13.text: Peter Parker offers to head to the Hunter base on his own, reminding Miles Morales to work on his college acceptance essay. He lets Miles know that he will take care of Martin Li if he encounters him. Miles agrees and tells Peter to keep in touch. Peter arrives at the base, which is an abandoned foundry with a large group of Hunters surrounding the outer perimeter.

main:16.text: Peter's search for Kraven begins at the Solid Gold Pawn Shop in Little Odessa, where he presents the dagger fragment to the owner. The owner refuses to help, cryptically stating that "the flames have been lit" and that the city has become Kravinoff's jungle. From a nearby rooftop, Peter notices two pillars of smoke. As he approaches the closer one, Miles calls to check on him, concerned about his health.

main:22.text: The mission begins with a cutscene showing Spider-Man, having awoken from his rampage in the previous mission, on a rooftop reading a new article from Mary Jane Watson. Though Spider-Man is confused and angry about the article as it details reports about his violent rampage and he web zips away. It then cuts to Peter Parker entering Harry Osborn's room, where Harry is taking pills for his illness.

main:23.text: After his confrontation with Harry Osborn. Peter makes his way to Rio's office after getting a call from her about Miles still being missing after his confrontation with Kraven. When Peter arrives at Rio's office, He is bombarded with questions about Miles but only tells Rio that "I have it under control" still influenced by the symbiote.

main:24.text: Peter goes to Martin Li to find Miles. Li says that Miles is being held at Kraven's mansion and that Miles reminds him of Peter. Peter swings to the mansion and fights the Hunters. He then interrogates one, and after his life is threatened, he tells Peter where Miles is. Peter jumps in and is trapped in a ''unbreakable cage''. Kraven believes that Spider-Man wouldn't hold back if he had motivation.

main:25.text: With the Venom symbiote removed and contained in an Oscorp container by Miles Morales, Peter Parker contacts Curt Connors, who instructs him to go to Oscorp, where there is a tank that will subdue the symbiote. When asked about his feelings with the symbiote off, Peter explains he is relieved it is over, but ashamed of his behavior.

main:26.text: In Oscorp Tower, Spider-Man managed to get out of the rubble, and took a look outside. To his horror, he quietly asks Harry what he has done, and how he can find Harry in a big city. Then, he looks at the Oscorp badges and realizes that he can use the radio frequencies to track him.

main:28.text: Peter and Miles arrived at City Hall only to find it utterly besieged, a nightmarish landscape of Symbiotes and ominous black tendrils snaking everywhere. They immediately leaped into action against a swarm of green Symbiotes, where Peter found his Web Grabber gadget particularly useful for managing the initial wave.

main:31.text: Accessing May's House at this point is the last chance players have to upgrade their suit tech, gadgets, and abilities until the end of the story. In the first time playing this mission, players will be locked wearing the Anti-Venom suit and Evolved suit respectively, though suit variety is unlocked for level replay and New Game+ afterwards.

boss:4.text: Venom, codenamed GR-35 and VNM-252 by Oscorp, is a major character in the Marvel's Spider-Man series. It would make cameo appearances in Marvel's Spider-Man and Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales before it appeared more prominently in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 as the main antagonist. It is an extraterrestrial symbiote that bonds with living organisms to use as hosts.
